B. Remove the athlete from play immediately to prevent second-impact syndrome, notify parents and coaches, and do not allow a return to play until cleared by a licensed healthcare professional.
C. Have the athlete perform vigorous sprint intervals to test whether their vision clears up.
D. Give the athlete aspirin on the bench and let them finish the current half before evaluating symptoms.

B. Remove the athlete from play immediately to prevent second-impact syndrome, notify parents and coaches, and do not allow a return to play until cleared by a licensed healthcare professional.

patrol_quiz_bank.correct_answer: B. Remove the athlete from play immediately to prevent second-impact syndrome, notify parents and coaches, and do not allow a return to play until cleared by a licensed healthcare professional.
